identity.title: Timeline of events in Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire

leadText:
In , Ash Ketchum travels to the Hoenn region with , meeting new in siblings and Max and reuniting with . Ash aims to collect eight Gym Badges to enter the Hoenn League, while May decides to instead focus on Pokémon Contests as a Pokémon Coordinator. Together, they face many challenges and threats, including the villainous Team Aqua and Team Magma, who plan to awaken Hoenn's Legendary Pokémon .

Following the Ever Grande Conference for Ash and the Hoenn Grand Festival for May, the group of friends reunites in Kanto, where Ash learns of a new kind of challenge: the , a set of seven battle facilities manned by extremely powerful Trainers known as Frontier Brains, spread out all across the Kanto region. With this new and intriguing challenge ahead of him, Ash sets on a new journey through Kanto alongside his friends to earn all seven Frontier Symbols, with May getting another shot at her dream of becoming a Top Coordinator by competing in Kanto's Pokémon Contests.

Simultaneously, Pokémon Chronicles features the adventures of Ash's former rivals and traveling companions, showcasing how their lives move on outside of meeting up or traveling with him.
